# masmundo, portfolio of Marifer Ruiz

> Marifer Ruiz is a Senior Art Director and multidisciplinary artist working at the intersection of art, storytelling, technology, and culture. With a background in Fine Arts and Marketing Strategy & Innovation, she develops campaigns, visual worlds, and brand experiences across digital, social, motion, and emerging AI technologies. Her studio name is Mas Mundo (masmundo).

## Work
- Abundance Island (Personal project, world-building): Abundance Theory: The Market. On this island, abundance organizes itself. It becomes structure, rhythm, routine. Abundance here is not chaotic. It's composed.
- Spinach Man for SaladPower (Character development, art direction): Spinach Man, a character for SaladPower: the journey of an ingredient fulfilling its potential, as a metaphor for our own. He was grown for more. So are you.
- Easy Love for Isadora (Music artwork, creative direction): Creative direction and cover art for Isadora's debut single, Easy Love: a visual identity as soft, nostalgic and timeless as the song itself.
- Part of the Process for Jones Road (Beauty campaign, AI art direction): A Jones Road campaign built on one idea: beauty isn't a pause to get ready. It happens between meetings, in transit, mid-work. She's already in motion.
- El Luchador for El Luchador Tequila (Brand identity, creative direction): Creative direction for El Luchador Tequila's visual identity: a world where lucha libre, agave and Mexican tradition come together to tell the brand's story.
- Summer in Gaia for Cult Gaia (Fashion campaign, AI art direction): A surreal campaign documenting an imagined island, shot like vintage travel photography from visitors discovering it decades ago.
- From Seed to Stitch for RAS (Fashion campaign, creative direction): A campaign for RAS, a plant-based clothing brand, that brings the hemp leaf into a new light and follows its garments from seed to stitch.
- Abundancia Eterna (Personal project, world-building): An extension of Abundance Island, set in Mexico: a celebration of the country's rich and colorful culture, where marigolds, cacti, catrinas and luchadores grow larger than life.
